measurement_notes.joint_angles: Interior 2D landmark angles in degrees. Straight joints are near 180; deeper flexion produces a smaller angle.
measurement_notes.perception_scores: face_forward, eyes_forward, face_calm, fist_left/right, and hand_left/right_open are 0-100 confidence scores, not joint angles.
measurement_notes.coaching_policy: Targets are broad beginner coaching bands for camera feedback, not clinical range-of-motion norms. Stop if movement causes pain, dizziness, or loss of balance.
measurement_notes.capture: Use the view named in each description, keep the full body visible, and begin with a controlled warm-up. Left/right targets assume an orthodox stance unless stated otherwise.
